meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自动监听指定Linear团队的所有issue评论，并对每条评论进行回复。每个issue评论线程成为一个独立的对话会话。
howto.when: 当有人在已配置的Linear团队issue下发布评论时触发。需要先完成Linear应用和webhook的配置。

say.note: Claude会基于评论历史生成总结

say.text: 帮我分析这个bug的可能原因
say.note: Claude会检查讨论并给出建议

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically monitors all issue comments in the configured Linear team and replies to each one. Each issue comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a comment is posted on an issue in the configured Linear team. Requires setting up OAuth app or personal API key, webhook, and team config.

say_en.text: Summarize the discussion points of this issue
say_en.note: Claude generates a summary from comment history

say_en.text: Help me find the root cause of this bug
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the discussion and suggests solutions
